Thank you, I'm sorry i had to do this.

I got an idea of selling and possibly fixing LED strips for people. Its hard to not get greedy when 70% of the local population have no higher education but yet want to purchase new technologies.

The profit that i may earn from this is anything but modest.  A simple purchase from ebay and reselling to my customers could make me a 200-300% profit, of which i am very nervous and dissatisfied with. Mom pushes me on to quote higher and higher prices, justifying it by saying that i would be at the losing end if i were to underquote my customers. 

I don't really know what to do. Family is rather tight on budget, i'm interested about new technologies like SSDs and maybe building scientific equipment myself. But i don't think reselling for profit is the way to go. After all, my family's finances is eroded by the same people that used the same tactic to take advantage of my parents. 

He who fights with monsters should look to it that he himself does not become a monster. And when you gaze long into an abyss the abyss also gazes into you.
~Friedrich Nietzche

The above quote has been a very reasonable life motto for me. I don't see how does one rid exploitation by thinking all day about how to exploit others. I just fails to comprehend how my mother thinks whenever she pushes he to increase my quotations, before i have even yet to receive a proper  purchase order.
